career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Uttarakhand are recruited into the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division) under the Uttarakhand Judicial Service Rules, 2005, framed in consultation with the High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital. Pay scales and career progression are governed by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Progression follows Assured Career Progression (ACP) scale upgrades at 5-year intervals and promotion to the Higher Judicial Service.

exam_scheme.note: The Uttarakhand Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination is conducted in three successive stages under the Uttarakhand Judicial Service Rules, 2005: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening test consisting of General Knowledge and Law), Main Examination (Written descriptive papers totaling 850 merit marks plus a qualifying computer practical test), and Viva-Voce (Personality Test carrying 100 marks). Final selection merit is prepared out of 950 marks.

papers.paper_name: Paper I: The Present Day (Current Affairs, Legal Developments, Constitution & Jurisprudence)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; minimum aggregate threshold across written papers applies

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Language (Translation English to Hindi 30 marks, Translation Hindi to English 30 marks, English Précis 40 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; evaluated for linguistic precision and translation proficiency

papers.paper_name: Paper III: Law Paper I — Substantive Law (Contracts, Partnership, Torts, Transfer of Property, Specific Relief, Hindu Law & Muslim Law)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; testing substantive jurisprudence and application

papers.paper_name: Paper IV: Law Paper II — Procedure and Evidence (Law of Evidence, CPC, CrPC, Principles of Pleading)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; covers civil and criminal procedure and framing of charges

papers.paper_name: Paper V: Law Paper III — Penal, Revenue and Local Laws (IPC/BNS and Uttar Pradesh / Uttarakhand Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act as applicable in Uttarakhand)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper; covers state tenancy, land revenue, and criminal penal provisions

papers.paper_name: Basic Knowledge of Computer Operation Practical Examination (Windows, MS Word, Excel, Access, Internet)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40 marks (40%) required to qualify; marks are not added to final merit

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in the State of Uttarakhand receive compensation fixed uniformly across India by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) as directed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India (WP(C) No. 643/2015). Direct recruit Civil Judges enter at SNJPC Level J-1 in the pay scale ₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520, supplemented by extensive judicial perquisites.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UKPSC Advt. No. 04/E-2/DR/Civil Judge/2024-25 & Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC)
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from SNJPC Level J-1 Entry Basic Pay (₹77,840), Dearness Allowance at 58% (₹45,147), House Rent Allowance (16% in Dehradun / Tier-II city or 8% in other judicial stations, or designated official judicial bungalow/quarter), Sumptuary Allowance (₹1,500/month), Medical Allowance, and Conveyance/Vehicle allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory NPS defined contribution (10% on Basic + DA = ₹12,299) and judicial deductions.
official_perks: Official judicial residential accommodation (bungalow / government quarter) or HRA at admissible rates
Robe allowance of ₹12,000 admissible once every 3 years
Conveyance allowance / official vehicle with driver entitlement or monthly fuel reimbursement
Electricity and water charges reimbursement up to prescribed monthly limits
Telephone, mobile, and broadband reimbursement up to ₹2,000 per month
Comprehensive medical facilities and full reimbursement under Uttarakhand Judicial Medical Rules
Home orderly / domestic help assistance allowance
Leave travel concession (LTC) and home town travel concessions
